WriteToMicroBatchDataSourceV1(ForeachBatchSink, $VAR_1$, $VAR_2$, Append)
:- Project([__broker_metadata, raw_value, get_json_object(CAST(raw_value AS STRING), $VAR_3$) AS __dataset_name])
   :- Project([__broker_metadata, data AS raw_value])
      :- Project([partitionKey, data, stream, shardId, sequenceNumber, approximateArrivalTimestamp, struct(approximateArrivalTimestamp, shardId, sequenceNumber) AS __broker_metadata])
         :- StreamingDataSourceV2ScanRelation([partitionKey, data, stream, shardId, sequenceNumber, approximateArrivalTimestamp], $VAR_7$, $VAR_8$)
